periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Approximately 45 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis, angled downwards towards the rostrum.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Oval-shaped with an approximate 1.8:1 length-to-width ratio along the dominant axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Distinct downward tapering towards the muzzle, creating a teardrop-shaped profile.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Broad, shallow U-shape across the posterior margin of the band.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Thick, occupying approximately 25-30% of the visible torso length between the neck and hindquarters.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide separation, approximately 2.5 times the width of a single ear unit.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, semicircular curvature at the superior boundary.

other_distinctive_markers: Significant brownish-tan chromatic shift in the fur across the posterior lumbar and pelvic regions compared to the white cranial fur.
